interface.defaultPrompt: Run e2e-test-help to see current Gate B status and capabilities
interface.longDescription: This skill family targets E2E specification authoring, review, repair and proof reconciliation. Core specification kernel (default/help/author/review/repair) is stable with CANDIDATE_QUALIFIED qualification; browser extension (implement/execute) is experimental. Provider defaults to NOT_ENABLED; requires explicit project binding.
